description.value: The Observatory is a fine-dining restaurant housed in a mountaintop chalet at the Peak of Grouse Mountain, with panoramic windows overlooking the city lights of Vancouver. Guests reach the restaurant via the Blue Grouse Gondola or Red Skyride, with mountain access complimentary for diners holding advance reservations. The menu features multi-course West Coast cuisine paired with Okanagan wines, alongside a dedicated vegan tasting menu offered on selected Thursday evenings.

address.value: 6400 Nancy Greene Way, North Vancouver, BC V7R 4K9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, operating fine-dining restaurant at the summit of Grouse Mountain, with multiple pages showing current reservations, menus, and a vegan tasting event dated May 28th 2026 (today), confirming active operation. Phone (604.998.5045) and address (6400 Nancy Greene Way, North Vancouver, BC V7R 4K9) are confirmed from the website; OSM carries neither field. A dedicated Vegan Tasting Menu (six-course, plant-based, selected Thursdays) is explicitly described on the website, confirming vegetarian/vegan offering. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Restaurant sits at the summit of Grouse Mountain and is only reachable via the Blue Grouse Gondola or Red Skyride — not directly accessible by bike. Complimentary mountain access is included with an advance dinner reservation.

Website contains mixed seasonal language referencing a December winter-season reopening alongside what appears to be current summer service; exact seasonal operating schedule and any off-season closures should be verified.
OSM record carries no address or phone fields; both sourced from website only (6400 Nancy Greene Way, North Vancouver, BC V7R 4K9; 604.998.5045).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant with current reservations and menus confirmed on the website. Mountain-top location requires gondola access but is publicly accessible to any diner with an advance reservation.
